title: Tree-sitter: a new parsing system for programming tools - GitHub Universe 2017
summary: Max Brunsfeld of GitHub presents Tree-sitter, a parsing system for programming tools that supports incremental, error-tolerant parsing. He demos its integration into GitHub.com and Atom for syntax highlighting and code navigation.
why: Recommended as the canonical introduction to tree-sitter and why fast incremental parsing enables live editor support.

quote.text: There is a long (42 minutes) but worth to watch talk about tree-sitter
